target.name: Braxusx/FarCry2VR local contribution: v2 provenance and sampled motion review

question: Can the debug runner require independent temporal stereo observations and its offline tools reject incompatible or changed evidence while retaining production authority and distinct visual/HMD review?
claim: Source and harness controls establish required per-sample acknowledgements, full run provenance, stricter stereo applied-pose/clock/context matching, compatible-baseline checks and hash-bound review artifacts. Missing/repeated samples, mixed environments or applied poses, undeclared settings, stale clocks, changed images/reports and failed runs are rejected. Three independently rebuilt broken variants fail assertions. Normal/debug x86 DLLs compile with payload exclusion/inclusion. This confirms the inspected mechanism and offline controls, not native execution, skinning-consumer timing, actual movement pixels, wrist/elbow quality or headset acceptance.
method: Python 3.12.3: 16 receipt methods and 13 review methods, including synthetic file comparisons, artifact tampering, copied-receipt validation and CLI subprocess checks. CMake/MSBuild 18.5.4 Win32 Release: 58 CTest groups. GCC 16.2.0 MSYS2 Rev3 x86: seven portable groups with -Wall -Wextra -Werror; mod/tests/check_scenario_mutants.ps1 rebuilt mixed-applied-pose, endpoint-only and old-sample-ack variants, each returning assertion exit 1 at its intended witness. mod/build-local.ps1 built isolated normal/debug DLLs, checked PE32/i386, DirectInput8Create and ASCII/UTF-16 payload inclusion/exclusion. Both retain 31 prior warnings. A 22-sample synthetic demo generated and reverified stereo and A/B bundles; Node v24.19.0 exercised the generated HTML script with document/timer stubs, not a browser. The registered-project receipt template was initialized under ignored build and adapted to the actual unregistered donor identity for local validation. Prior receipt: 20261026-scenario-runner-1. No game, XR session, deployment, runtime switch, remote write or fleet intake.

identity.reason: Full implementation commit, stamped source/tests/logs and exact output DLL sizes and SHA-256 values identify this checkpoint.

instrument.reason: Nonempty portable/helper tests, real file/hash validation, x86 builds and explicit assertion-failing mutants were inspected. The HTML replay probe used owned synthetic output with a DOM stub, not a real browser or game.

control.reason: Positive fixtures complete; malformed/missing/stale or incompatible fixtures are rejected. Rebuilt mutants remove actual pose matching, intermediate samples or independent acknowledgements and fail their targeted assertions.

scene.reason: Offline source/harness work only. No native save, level, controller runtime, game frame, GPU consumer or headset was exercised.

restore.reason: Persistent local source edits and isolated ignored fixture/mutant/build output. No running game, deployed DLL, active configuration or shared runtime required restoration.

baseline.reason: All 58 offline CTest groups and both x86 builds pass. Native and HMD baselines were NOT_MEASURED; this does not approve release or clear their gates.

limits: Run labels and external save/profile hashes are declarations, not proof of loaded native state. Module hashes identify files, not a fresh measurement of every mapped byte. Topology fingerprints do not identify mesh weights or establish native lifetimes. Native capture bracketing, GPU queue/bone-cache consumption and actual image quality were not executed. Sampling remains synchronous, pre-DLSS, bounded and observer-affecting; it is not continuous video, final XR composition or performance evidence. The replay probe checks JS behavior against DOM stubs, not browser rendering or visual quality. Review records bind bytes and self-declared attribution, not authenticated human identity. A sampled-image PASS never grants headset acceptance. Existing GOG mapping, saved-hold provenance, reload acknowledgement, physical steering and HMD wrist/elbow gates remain open; ArmRigFix stays default-off.

do_not_repeat.approach: Treat matched dimensions or a generic success marker as a sufficient A/B baseline, or relabel repeated endpoint captures as intermediate motion
do_not_repeat.reason: These omit provenance/context/actual applied-pose and independent sample coverage; retained fixture and rebuilt-mutant controls discriminate the errors.
do_not_repeat.reopen_when: A versioned evidence schema explicitly preserves equivalent identities and temporal coverage with independent controls; actual native/visual acceptance still requires separate execution.

next_action: Keep local. Separately authorize one native run on a verified disposable scene with AFW/DLSS/scope disabled; validate v2 receipts and inspect both-eye samples and native consumer timing. No release or HMD acceptance from these controls. Fleet submission is deferred: donor checkout is unregistered and user scope is offline/local-only.
